title: Get the reference
description: Returns the product's reference: its stages, then its kinds in stage order with the product's own after Lathe's, its tables by role, its relations, every check (Lathe's in run order, the engine's own, then the product's) and the coverage gaps.

title: Find a record's data file
description: Returns the full path of the data file that holds the record: its kind's file in its product's data folder; refused when no record has the ID.

title: Get a use case whole
description: Reads a use case whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: the record asked for and its kind, the use case's own details and actors, its UC requirements each with its tests and the steps that fulfill it, and its flows by interface, each with its steps path by path in order (with the links each starts) and its flow test.

title: List a capability's use cases
description: Lists the use cases of a capability, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a use case
description: The next free ID for a use case (under a capability), UC requirement or flow (under a use case), use case test (under a requirement), or flow step or flow test (under a flow): one past the highest in use, a flow's ending in the number of the first interface it has no flow through yet.

title: Get a product whole
description: Reads a product whole, by its ID, the ID of an open question or interface in it, or the name of a kind it declares: its own details, roles, business outcomes and domains, declared kinds with their fields, relations, open questions with what they are about, and interfaces with the flows through each.

title: List a product's interfaces
description: Lists the interfaces of a product, by ID, with their titles and kinds.

title: Get the next ID in a product
description: The next free ID for an open question (under a product or a domain) or an interface (under a product): one past the highest in use.

title: List the products
description: Lists every product, by ID, with its title, and its icon and color when it gives them.

title: Get a business outcome
description: Reads a business outcome whole, by its ID: its statement, measure and target, the tests and records that measure it, and the capabilities that serve it.

title: List a product's business outcomes
description: Lists the business outcomes of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next business outcome ID
description: The next free ID for a business outcome of a product: one past the highest in use.

title: Get an extension record
description: Reads a record of a product's own kind whole: its kind, its own details, the links it starts by relation, and the packages it uses.

title: List a parent's extension records of a kind
description: Lists the records of a product kind under one parent, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get an entry point
description: Reads an entry point whole, by its ID: its own details, the packages it uses and the standard rules it meets.

title: List a domain's entry points
description: Lists the entry points of a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next entry point ID
description: The next free ID for an entry point of a domain: one past the highest in use.

title: Get a tooling record
description: Reads a tooling record whole, by its ID: its own details, the packages it uses and the standard rules it meets.

title: List a domain's tooling
description: Lists the tooling records of a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next tooling ID
description: The next free ID for a tooling record of a domain: one past the highest in use.

title: Get the next extension record ID
description: The next free ID for a record of a product kind under its parent, by the kind's declared ID pattern: one past the highest in use.

title: Get a domain whole
description: Reads a domain whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: the record asked for and its kind, the domain's own details, its capabilities in order with the outcomes they serve and their use cases, its terms bottom-up with the terms they build on, its domain services with their services and tests, and its repositories with the aggregates they persist.

title: List a product's domains
description: Lists the domains of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a domain
description: The next free ID for a capability, term, domain service or repository (under a domain), or a service or domain service test (under a domain service): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a test data set whole
description: Reads a test data set whole as its readers read it, by its ID: its environment, accounts and records, how to prepare and reset it, the file that builds it, and the tests that start from it.

title: List a domain's test data sets
description: Lists the test data sets of a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next test data set ID
description: The next free ID for a test data set of a domain: one past the highest in use.

title: Get a pattern whole
description: Reads a pattern whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of any rule, rule test or slot in it: the record asked for and its kind, the pattern's own details, its settings in order, its rules by ID, each with its tests (with the test data sets they start from), and its slots by ID.

title: List a product's patterns
description: Lists the patterns of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a pattern
description: The next free ID for a pattern rule or a slot (under a pattern) or a pattern rule test (under a rule): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a standard whole
description: Reads a standard whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of any rule or rule test in it: the record asked for and its kind, the standard's own details, and its rules by ID, each with the records that meet it and its tests (with the test data sets they start from).

title: List a product's standards
description: Lists the standards of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a standard
description: The next free ID for a standard rule (under a standard) or a standard rule test (under a rule): one past the highest in use.

title: Get an aggregate whole
description: Reads an aggregate whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: the record asked for and its kind, the aggregate's own details, its entities (the root first) with their fields, the entities they hold, their data models, commands and tables, its invariants with their rules and tests, and the domain events that happen to it with what raises and hears them.

title: List a domain's aggregates
description: Lists the aggregates of a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in an aggregate
description: The next free ID for an aggregate (under a domain), an entity or invariant (under an aggregate), a data model (under an entity), or a rule or invariant test (under an invariant): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a domain event whole
description: Reads a domain event whole as its readers read it, by its ID or its event type's: the record asked for and its kind, the event's own details, the fields it carries in order, its event type with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses, and the commands that raise it and the policies that hear it.

title: List an aggregate's domain events
description: Lists the domain events that happen to an aggregate, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a domain event
description: The next free ID for a domain event (under an aggregate) or its event type (under the event): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a command whole
description: Reads a command whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: the record asked for and its kind, the command's own details, the events it raises, the specifications it checks and the domain services it calls, its handler, its policies with the event each hears, their event handlers and tests, and the endpoints that expose it.

title: List an entity's commands
description: Lists the commands that change an entity, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a command
description: The next free ID for a command (under an entity), a command handler or policy (under a command), or an event handler or policy test (under a policy): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a specification whole
description: Reads a specification whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of its predicate or test: the record asked for and its kind, the specification's own details and the domain its ID names, the aggregates it reads, its predicate with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses, and its test with the test data sets it starts from.

title: List a domain's specifications
description: Lists the specifications of a domain (those whose ID names it), by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a specification
description: The next free ID for a specification (under its domain: one past the highest in use), or the one ID of a predicate or specification test (under its specification).

title: Get a value object whole
description: Reads a value object whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: the record asked for and its kind, the value object's own details and the product its ID names, its fields in order, its constraints by ID each with its test (and the test data sets it starts from), and its value type with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: List a product's value objects
description: Lists the value objects of a product (those whose ID names it), by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a value object
description: The next free ID for a value object (under its product) or a constraint (under its value object): one past the highest in use; or the one ID of a value type (under its value object) or a constraint test (under its constraint).

title: Get a read model whole
description: Reads a read model whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: the record asked for and its kind, the read model itself and its fields in order, what it reads, calls and is fed by, its queries by ID each with what it selects by and calls and its handler, its projection and its reader (each piece of code with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses).

title: List a domain's read models
description: Lists the read models of a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a read model
description: The next free ID for a read model (under its domain) or a query (under its read model): one past the highest in use; or the one ID of a projection or a reader (under its read model) or a query handler (under its query).

title: Get a table whole
description: Reads a table whole as its readers read it, by its ID: its own details, the entity, read model or domain it sits under, its keys in order, the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: List the tables under a record
description: Lists the tables under an entity, a read model or a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next table ID
description: The next free ID for a table: the one ID of an entity's or read model's table, or a domain's next own table, one past the highest in use.

title: Get a view whole
description: Reads a view whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of any requirement or test in it: the record asked for and its kind, the view's own details, and its requirements by ID, each with its tests (with the test data sets they start from).

title: List a product's views
description: Lists the views of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a view
description: The next free ID for a view (under a product), a view requirement (under a view) or a view test (under a view requirement): one past the highest in use.

title: Get an endpoint whole
description: Reads an endpoint whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: the record asked for and its kind, the endpoint's own details, its handler (with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses), and its API requirements by ID, each with its tests (with the test data sets they start from).

title: List the endpoints of a command or query
description: Lists the endpoints that expose a command or query, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in an endpoint
description: The next free ID for an endpoint (under a command or query), an API requirement or endpoint handler (under an endpoint) or an endpoint test (under an API requirement): one past the highest in use.

title: Get an integration whole
description: Reads an integration whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: the record asked for and its kind, the integration's own details, its adapter (with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses), and its integration tests by ID (with the test data sets they start from).

title: List a product's integrations
description: Lists the integrations of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in an integration
description: The next free ID for an integration (under a product), or an adapter or integration test (under an integration): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a UI component whole
description: Reads a UI component whole as its readers read it: the record asked for and its kind, the component's own details, and the views it renders, the view requirements it builds, the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses, each list sorted.

title: List a product's UI components
description: Lists the UI components of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID for a UI component
description: The next free ID for a UI component of a product: one past the highest in use.

title: Get a storage requirement whole
description: Reads a storage requirement whole as its readers read it, by its ID or the ID of one of its storage requirement tests: the record asked for and its kind, the requirement's own details, the aggregate or read model it is about, the repository or reader that builds it with the data store that names, and its storage requirement tests with the test data sets each starts from.

title: List an aggregate's or read model's storage requirements
description: Lists the storage requirements of an aggregate or read model, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next storage requirement ID
description: The next free ID for a storage requirement (under its aggregate or read model) or a storage requirement test (under its storage requirement): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a data store whole
description: Reads a data store whole as its readers read it: its own details, the product or domain it sits under, the integration that reaches it, and the repositories, readers and tables stored in it.

title: List a product's or domain's data stores
description: Lists the data stores of a product (its own and its domains') or of a domain, by ID, with their titles and kinds.

title: Get the next data store ID
description: The next free ID for a data store under its product or domain: one past the highest in use.

title: Get the workspace's problems
description: one load of the product's data, then every problem: `data-refused` errors when the store refuses the data (and nothing else), else Lathe's checks then each product's, in DS01's order, a product's check reporting only on records of its product. `lathe check`, the MCP `check` tool and the server's kept checks' run (which the Problems, Coverage, Trace and Record trace reads read) all read it.

title: List a product's problems
description: Lists a product's problems, errors before warnings, grouped by check, then the problems that belong to no product under Workspace, with the errors and warnings counted. Runs the checks first.

title: Get a check whole
description: Reads a check whole, by its name: its product, place in the run order, severity, summary, explanation, query and kinds.

title: List the checks that run on a product
description: Lists the checks that run on a product, Lathe's first and then the product's own, each in its run order, with its severity and summary.

title: Get the product's limits
description: Reads a product's limits: the most children of one kind a record should hold and the most entities an aggregate should hold, its own or the defaults.

title: List a product's record summaries
description: Lists every record of a product's space (its own and those of no product) as its pages name it: its kind, title, parent, product and domain, its group heading, a test's state and level, what it names in code, its data file and line and a digest of its data; and the links among them.

title: Get a product's nav
description: Gets a product's nav tree: Shared with what the product shares, then each domain in ID order; in each its stages, in each stage one folder per kind in kind order with the records that start a branch there and what folds under each, then the kinds outside the stages.

title: Get a focus's frame
description: The picture the camera frames around a record or group on its product's graph map: its parent, the focus and its descendants down to the chosen depth, leaving out hidden kinds and anything reached only through them, each node with its level and its place in it, and the parent lines between them.

title: Get the ERD map
description: Gets a product's ERD map: every domain's region, each aggregate's boundary with its entities (the root first) and their fields and types, and the has-one, has-many and reference-by-ID lines between entities.

title: Get a record's history
description: The commits that changed a record's data (its own fields, the parts it owns and the links it starts), newest first, twenty a page with whether older ones remain, each with its date, author, subject and every part added, removed or changed field by field, then its changes not committed yet; a folder outside git gets a calm `no-repo` answer instead.

title: List the spaces
description: Every product as a space, in product ID order, each with its icon or monogram, its color and its number of domains; the space the Reader was last in is marked, and each opens at the last page visited in it this session, else its product page.

title: Get what changed since a baseline
description: Lists the records that differ between a product's baseline (the last commit with `commit`, where the branch left the default branch with `branch`, or a commit's hash) and its data now: each added, removed or changed, with its own fields that changed, its parts and the links it starts.

title: Get the workspace
description: Returns a product repo's workspace: every record with its parts, links and file facts, and the checks' problems and coverage. Data the store refuses returns no records and one data-refused error per refusal; a config for another schema version is refused.

title: List the commands
description: Returns every keyboard command in the keymap's order, with its title, group and context, its keys for the platform as the person bound them (leaving out any key the browser keeps), its default keys, and whether it changed and may be bound.

title: List the themes
description: Returns the built-in themes, Lathe first, then the person's own, with the one in use (Lathe when the chosen one is gone), the color mode, and for a copy the built-in theme it came from.

title: Get a theme file
description: Returns a theme as its versioned file: format, version, name and its light, dark and other token values in a stable order, ready to save and share.

title: List the recent folders
description: Returns the recent folders, latest first, each shown from the home folder as `~`, as File › Open Recent lists them.

title: Get the data's changes as they happen
description: Tells an open view, as it happens, that the workspace it shows changed, so it loads the data again.

title: List a folder's Claude Code sessions
description: The window's folder's sessions, newest first, each by its name, summary or first prompt, with running or just written marked; the `claude` the chat runs and whether it is signed in (`claude auth status`); and the mode the folder's next chat starts in.

title: Get what the Reader is looking at
description: The window's view, focus, stage and selection, named by ID, kind and title, offered to the Agent and to the Owner alike; refused when no window is connected.

title: Get the window's chat
description: The window's whole chat as one patch, for a view that loads or reloads; the patches that follow it come as the chat changes.

title: Get the meta model
description: Gets the meta model: every kind (Lathe's in reading order, then each product's own) with its label, stage, parents and ID scope, the six stages, each pair of kinds a relation may link with its words both ways, and each kind's fields.

title: Get the window's voice support
description: Whether the window can dictate, why not, the microphone's permission and whether end-of-turn detection reads the voice; the microphone control is offered only when it can.

title: List the chat's skills
description: The skills and commands the message box lists after a slash, by name, each with its description and whether it is a skill or a command.

title: Get coverage counts
description: Gets a product's coverage, for its records outside every domain and then each domain: per obligation kind how many are designed, built, proved and not automated yet out of the total, its tests by state, and its gaps. Runs the checks first.

title: List coverage gaps
description: Coverage.gaps; the gap callouts and the not-designed, not-built and not-proved warnings

title: Get test counts by state
description: Returns one entry per domain, and one per product for what lies outside every domain, with its tests counted as automated, manual and not automated yet, ordered by product then domain.

title: List the pattern rules a domain owes
description: The rules each following domain owes: Patterns we follow, the views of a pattern and of a pattern rule, and Traceability's owing domains.

title: Get a record's traceability
description: Gets one record's traceability: for an obligation its chain (designed by, built by with each built or not, proved by) and how each owing domain stands on it with its gaps; for a use case its UC requirements, each judged; for a test what it proves and how it is run; and its other links both ways by relation. Runs the checks first.

title: Find the files that are missing or silent
description: The checks that read the file facts: a test's file missing or not naming it, a manual test's file naming it, and a technical record's file missing.

title: List routes traced both ways
description: Address facts (each operation's and view's address, and whether the files of what implements it name it) and served addresses (each address the code serves): the checks that an operation's or view's address is named in its files, and the gap for a served address with no record.

title: Find the tables their files do not define
description: The check that a kind of record kept in its own storage is defined as the spec says by the file that creates it, a query of the stored-record facts.

title: Get a following whole
description: Reads a domain's or use case's following of a pattern whole: the value it gives each of the pattern's settings.

title: List the patterns a follower follows
description: Lists the patterns a domain or use case follows, by ID.

title: Find the packages no record uses
description: The packages the product's package manifests list that no technical record names: one package-not-accounted-for gap per product.

title: List a pattern's followers
description: Lists a pattern's followers by domain, in ID order: whether the domain itself follows it, and each of its use cases that does, each with the value it gives each of the pattern's settings.

title: Get the outcomes a record serves
description: Gets the business outcomes a record serves, and the use cases it serves them through: those of each use case whose capability serves an outcome and that reaches the record. Worked out from the data on every read; none when nothing reaches it.

title: List what serves a product's outcomes
description: Lists each record of a product's space that serves a business outcome, with its outcomes and the use cases it serves them through, and the aggregates, read models and obligations of its space no outcome reaches. Worked out from the data on every read.

title: List a product's trace rows
description: Lists each use case of a product's space once, from the business outcomes its capability serves to its acceptance tests: its UC requirements with their gaps and tests, the aggregates and read models its steps change and read, its flows with each step's design (what it fulfills, its view and view requirements, its operations and API requirements, its integrations) and technical chain (interface parts, operations or channels, the records that handle them, what reads and writes the data, where it is stored, and the connectors to integrations), its flow tests, the lower obligations its tests rest on, and its status per stage. Runs the checks first.
